snapshot.Description: A CUDA compute framework for sciBASIC#: zero-dependency Driver API and NVRTC interop for device, context, stream and memory management, JIT compilation of embedded .cu kernels, plus an IL emitter that translates marked .NET methods into CUDA C source.

snapshot.Description: A GPU tensor extension for sciBASIC#: device-resident dense and CSR sparse tensor storage with host/device caches, hand-written double-precision CUDA kernels for GEMM, softmax, convolution and pooling, plus a CUDA backend for the machine learning tensor compute interface.
snapshot.Title: GPU Tensor Types and CUDA Kernels for the ILCuda Runtime

snapshot.Description: A low-level binary data toolkit for sciBASIC#: endianness-aware BinaryReader and BinaryWriter extensions, a Java-style ByteBuffer, BZip2, LZW, LZ4 and LZMA compression codecs, XDR encoding and a Python pickle codec for parsing custom binary file formats.

snapshot.Title: Managed SQLite3 Database File Reader and Writer

snapshot.Description: A tabular data framework for sciBASIC#: R-style DataFrame and DataSet objects, streaming CSV and ARFF readers and writers, reflection-based storage providers that map .NET classes to table rows and columns, and LINQ-style streams for querying ultra-large datasets.

snapshot.Description: Runs a piped graph query language over HTML/XML documents, combining CSS selectors, XPath expressions, attribute selectors and built-in functions to extract nodes, text and values and emit them as JSON.

snapshot.Description: A text differencing toolkit for sciBASIC#: implements the Myers O((N+M)D) shortest edit script algorithm to compare files, line sequences and character strings, producing structured diff blocks, unified and side-by-side output, and a sequence similarity score.
snapshot.Title: Myers O(ND) Diff Algorithm for Text Comparison

snapshot.Description: A data mining library for sciBASIC#: K-means, DBSCAN, HDBSCAN, fuzzy C-means and spectral clustering, Apriori association rules, ID3 decision trees, self-organizing maps, plus a unified evaluation framework with ROC/AUC curves and clustering quality indices.

snapshot.Description: Learns dynamic Bayesian networks from observation sequences, combining initial and transition Bayes nets with MDL, log-likelihood and Bayesian scoring functions, optimum branching search and EM parameter fitting.

snapshot.Description: An agglomerative hierarchical clustering library for sciBASIC#: the BIRCH CF-tree preclustering engine for large streaming datasets, single, complete, average and weighted linkage strategies, weighted distance maps and a reusable dendrogram tree builder.
snapshot.Title: Hierarchical Clustering Engine with BIRCH and Linkage Strategies

snapshot.Description: Implements hidden Markov models and Markov chains with forward, backward, Viterbi, Bayes and Baum-Welch EM algorithms, so you can score, decode and re-estimate state sequences from observation chains in sciBASIC#.

snapshot.Description: PaCMAP dimensionality reduction for sciBASIC#: preserves local and global structure by optimising neighbour, mid-near and further point pairs with a three-phase loss and an Adagrad optimiser over tensor data.

snapshot.Title: Graph Theory Algorithms, Network Models and Graph Search

snapshot.Description: Provides graph representation learning for sciBASIC#: node2vec biased random walks with word2vec, whole-graph graph2vec vectors, and ComplEx knowledge-graph embedding variants trained by AdaGrad.

snapshot.Description: A deep learning toolkit for sciBASIC#: trainable convolutional networks with SGD, AdaGrad and Adam trainers, a CeNiN CNN reader for image inference, character-level RNNs, a hand-written Transformer encoder-decoder with explicit backward passes, and general feed-forward neural networks.
snapshot.Title: Deep Learning Framework: CNN, RNN, Transformer and ANN Models

snapshot.Description: Graph neural network library for sciBASIC#, providing GCN and graph-attention layers, GRU and RNN recurrent graph layers, temporal graph snapshots, and graph classification models with SGD and Adam training.

snapshot.Title: Pure VB.NET Tensor Engine with NumPy API and Pluggable Compute Backend

snapshot.Description: Generative modelling library for sciBASIC#: a graph variational autoencoder with GCN encoder and inner-product decoder, a Gaussian mixture VAE with categorical latents, and an EM-trained Gaussian mixture model.
snapshot.Title: Variational Autoencoders: Graph VAE, Gaussian Mixture VAE and GMM

snapshot.Description: Gradient boosting toolkit for sciBASIC#: reads and scores XGBoost model files through GBTree, GBLinear and Dart boosters, and trains ternary gradient boosting trees with categorical and missing value handling.

snapshot.Title: 3D Gaussian Splatting Scene Reconstruction and Rendering

snapshot.Description: A statistical hypothesis testing toolkit for sciBASIC#: one-way ANOVA F-tests, Kruskal-Wallis non-parametric group comparison with Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction, plus PCA, PLS-DA and OPLS-DA multivariate analysis over unified numeric tables.
